c74object.name: evi_svfs_filters
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_svfs_filters.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_svfs_filters.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_svfs_filters.genexpr file also requires:
evi_interp.genexpr
About this File:
This file contains the actual DSP filter sections used throughout evieve. The two different types of filter sections (here labled 'TPT' and 'LTO' but actually the same principle), are alternative ways of achieving a similar result. The 'TPT' sections are methematical and well suited to nonlinearising, the 'LTO' sections are circuit analysed and well suited to EQ building, but the choice of which to use is largely circumstance specific.

entry.name: tptSvf ( )
entry.description:
The linear TPT filter, after Zavalishin, we use this filter section to create our filter types by summing the outputs
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, g coefficient
In 3: type=input: r, r coefficient
In 4: type=input: a, a coefficient
Return 1: yL, Lowpass output
Return 2: yB, Bandpass output
Return 3: yH, Highpass output

entry.name: tptSvfReset ( )
entry.description:
Same as 'tptSvf()' but with state reset input
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, g coefficient
In 3: type=input: r, r coefficient
In 4: type=input: a, a coefficient
In 5: type=input: reset, Sample accurate reset of internal filter state ('clear')
Return 1: yL, Lowpass output
Return 2: yB, Bandpass output
Return 3: yH, Highpass output

entry.name: tptSvfOnePole ( )
entry.description:
Onepole version of the TPT filter, for building odd ordered cascades etc, use 'cL' 'cH' to mix
In 1: type=input: x,
In 2: type=input: g, g coefficient
Return 1: lp, Lowpass output
Return 2: hp, Highpass output

entry.name: tptSvf2_2x ( )
entry.description:
2x oversampling on the linear twopole filter with all three outputs, this works, but is not too successful in the task of extending HF response
In 1: type=input: XIN,
In 2: type=input: g, g coefficient
In 3: type=input: r, r coefficient
In 4: type=input: a, a coefficient
Return 1: yL, Lowpass output
Return 2: yB, Bandpass output
Return 3: yH, Highpass output

entry.name: tptSvfUnit ( )
entry.description:
Simple coefficients calculator for single 'tptSvf()' unit as used in [evi.svf~]
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: Q, Q
In 3: type=param (optional): os, default: 0, (Optional), external oversampling factor if used with 'tptSvf2_2x()'
Return 1: g, g coefficient
Return 2: r, r coefficient
Return 3: h, h coefficient

entry.name: tptSvfExternal ( )
entry.description:
Version of the filter with state read in/read out from/to Data() for gen~ style cascades
In 1: type=input: x,
In 2: type=input: g, g coefficient
In 3: type=input: r, r coefficient
In 4: type=input: a, a coefficient
In 5: type=input: s1i, State 1 input
In 6: type=input: s2i, State 2 input
Return 1: yL, Lowpass output
Return 2: yB, Bandpass output
Return 3: yH, Highpass output
Return 4: , State 1 output
Return 5: , State 2 output

entry.name: svfSection ( )
entry.description:
The linear LTO filter, after Simper, with a single output mixed by the 'm' mixing gains
In 1: type=input: v0, Audio input
In 2: type=input: a1, a1 coefficient
In 3: type=input: a2, a2 coefficient
In 4: type=input: a3, a3 coefficient
In 5: type=input: m0, low mixing gain
In 6: type=input: m1, band mixing gain
In 7: type=input: m2, high mixing gain
Return 1: Filter, Mixed filter output

entry.name: svfSectionReset ( )
entry.description:
Same as 'svfSection()' but with state reset input
In 1: type=input: v0, Audio input
In 2: type=input: a1, a1 coefficient
In 3: type=input: a2, a2 coefficient
In 4: type=input: a3, a3 coefficient
In 5: type=input: m0, low mixing gain
In 6: type=input: m1, band mixing gain
In 7: type=input: m2, high mixing gain
In 8: type=input: reset, Sample accurate reset of internal filter state ('clear')
Return 1: Filter, Mixed filter output

entry.name: svfSectionOnePole ( )
entry.description:
Onepole version of the LTO filter, for building odd ordered cascades etc, use 'm0' 'm2' to mix
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: g, g coefficient
Return 1: lp, Lowpass output
Return 2: hp, Highpass output

entry.name: svfSectionStereo ( )
entry.description:
Utility stereo version of the LTO 'svfSection()' required for efficiency by some evieve processors
In 1: type=input: xL, Left audio input
In 2: type=input: xR, Right audio input
In 3: type=input: a1, a1 coefficient
In 4: type=input: a2, a2 coefficient
In 5: type=input: a3, a3 coefficient
In 6: type=input: m0, low mixing gain
In 7: type=input: m1, band mixing gain
In 8: type=input: m2, high mixing gain
Return 1: Filter Left, Left audio output
Return 2: Filter Right, Right audio output
